title: Shadows of Brimstone: City of the Ancients
subtitle: Weird-West Lovecraftian Dungeon Crawl Campaign
tagline: Strap on your six-shooters and delve into cursed gold mines and alien Otherworlds in a classic dungeon-crawler.
loreSummary: In the late 1890s, the boomtown of Brimstone struck the mother lode of Darkstone—a magical mineral that unleashed cosmic portals across the frontier. Create your custom Gunslinger, Saloon Girl, or US Marshal, battle eldritch abominations, and venture through tear rifts into ancient alien civilizations.
keyFeatures: Vibrant fusion of classic Wild West gunplay and Lovecraftian cosmic horror
Deep character progression: gain experience, level up skill trees, and endure permanent physical/sanity injuries
Frontier Town interlude: visit saloons, gambling halls, doctors, and churches to craft gear and buy upgrades
Otherworld portals leading to the freezing robotic ruins of the Targa Plateau

brimstone_ancient_city_saga.name: The Targa Plateau Saga (All 12 Core Adventures + Otherworld)
brimstone_ancient_city_saga.description: The complete campaign arc spanning 16 adventures delving through demon-infested mines, frontier town interludes, and alien gateways.

brimstone_greenhorn_mines.name: Greenhorn Frontier Arc (First 4 Mine Adventures)
brimstone_greenhorn_mines.description: An introductory 4-adventure campaign delving into initial gold mine shafts and visiting Brimstone Town for basic supplies.

brimstone_master_gunslinger.name: Legendary Darkstone Outlaw (All Missions & Targa Overlord)
brimstone_master_gunslinger.description: An exhaustive extended campaign conquering all high-threat void gates, elite monstrosities, and the Precursor Overlord.
